title: Replace OCX controls with modern equivalents
problem_statement: Outdated OCX controls are used in the application, which may not be supported in modern environments.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential application failure in modern environments.
suggested_approach: Identify modern equivalents for the OCX controls and replace them in the application.
success_criteria: All OCX controls are replaced with modern equivalents.
Application runs without errors in a modern environment.
